algorithm: Before assignment, reject every authored mutation presentation matching the frozen exposure registry manipulation/all-presentation corpus under the shared normalized equality/containment policy; then validate clean-audit source/context hashes and exact mutation clean-target, unique-edit, manipulation-check bindings.
Sort bases by sha256(seed + NUL + base_id + NUL + discovery), then base_id; group by public source file and sort equal groups by file path.
Depth-first assign each whole-file group to discovery before confirmation, prune impossible quotas, and fail after 500000 visited nodes.
Require exact quotas, at most two items per source file, at most four per historical task in each cohort, and file/source/context/base disjointness.
Order each cohort by sha256(seed + NUL + phase + NUL + base_id), then base_id; assign global IDs and contiguous 16-item shards.
path_policy: All package sibling inputs and outputs resolve relative to the script directory, independent of cwd.
failure: Emit INSUFFICIENT_ASSIGNMENT or ASSIGNMENT_SEARCH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; never pad, replace, reuse, or relax.
reference_policy: Separate phase references released only after an exact phase RAW manifest is immutable and hash-bound by release state.
